newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson wins Russia radio system order.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson wins Russia radio system order.

text.p: Swedish telecommunications company LM Ericsson AB said on Thursday it had signed a contract with AO Radio Tel for delivery of an EDACS private radio system for Saint Petersburg, Russia.
Ericsson said the system, with installation to begin in January 1997, would cover the city and surrounding areas.
It said four base stations would be put into operation in stage one, capable of serving 2,500 subscribers by September 1997. End users will be St Petersburg municipal services.
AO Radio Tel was founded in 1994 and this year received a licence from the Russian Ministry for Telecommunications, authorising its radio and telecommunication services in the 800 MHz range.
